name: KEYASIC
recent: KEYASIC 正在推进私下配售（Private Placement），并已获 Bursa Securities 批准将完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 14 日。公司于 2026 年 9 月与 CT Vision 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚建设 300MW 绿色 AI 数据中心。最新财报（截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日）的详细数据未提供。
notable: 公司与 CT Vision 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚建设 300MW 绿色 AI 数据中心。
Bursa Securities 批准公司将私下配售完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 14 日。
公司第 20 届常年股东大会于 2025 年 11 月 12 日举行，所有决议案均获通过。
risks: 私下配售尚未完成，公司已两次申请延长完成期限，最新延至 2027 年 4 月 14 日。
私下配售涉及新股发行，可能对现有股东持股产生摊薄影响。

news.title: Bursa Starts Week In The Green, KLCI Reclaims 1,710
Key ASIC, CT Vision plan 300MW green AI data centre in Malaysia

recent_en: KEYASIC is proceeding with its Private Placement and has obtained Bursa Securities' approval for a 6-month extension to complete it by 14 April 2027. In September 2026, the company signed an MOU with CT Vision to plan a 300MW green AI data centre in Malaysia. Detailed figures for the latest financial period ended 31 August 2026 were not provided.
notable_en: The company signed an MOU with CT Vision to plan a 300MW green AI data centre in Malaysia.
Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension for the company to complete its Private Placement by 14 April 2027.
The company's 20th AGM was held on 12 November 2025 and all resolutions were passed.
risks_en: The Private Placement is not yet completed; the company has sought extensions twice, with the latest deadline extended to 14 April 2027.
The Private Placement involves new share issuance, which may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
